verdict.rationale: The evidence shows TrueLayer reads account data from integrated banks and offers a providers endpoint listing supported banks. Nothing in the pack says these connections use bank-hosted OAuth rather than screen-scraped credentials, documents OAuth coverage specifically, or describes retiring legacy credential flows. A bank-coverage list and user consent are adjacent features, not evidence of this capability.

support.subject: As a developer, connections to major institutions use bank-hosted OAuth rather than screen-scraped credentials — the platform documents its OAuth coverage and how legacy credential flows are being retired
